summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for the new Design Requests Logo Sheet view (/design-requests-new?view=logos). Verified login flow, view toggles, physical-sample-only filtering, row content/actions, thumbnail generation for PDF/ZIP fixtures, PDF export endpoint behavior, mobile/desktop overflow, and Kanban/List/CSV regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality risk: /app/backend/routes/design_requests_new.py is very large (>700 lines; currently ~1800+). Split Logo Sheet endpoints/query builder/list/export concerns into focused modules/services to reduce regression risk and improve maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI thumbnail rendering can be async; wait ~2-3 seconds before asserting naturalWidth on thumbnail images. Fixture request IDs a481a225-f7a3-47cd-8dfb-87fa232a1437 (PDF) and ede89f70-e234-4bce-8e9a-01fdbe5f743f (ZIP) were present and rendered correctly during this run.
rca of the issue: No functional issue found in this scope. One initial thumbnail check returned false due to render timing; immediate retest with an additional wait confirmed successful thumbnail rendering.
